title: Trump’s EPA Move to Sideline Neighbors in AI Data Center Boom Sparks Fresh Backlash
description: Trump's EPA proposes letting states decide public input on pollution permits for AI data center power plants. Communities facing noise, emissions and higher bills push back hard.
